name: chat2skill
description: Automatically learn coding-agent memory and skills, retrieve local context, and enforce learned response constraints.

interface.shortDescription: Learn and retrieve memory and skills from agent conversations.
interface.longDescription: Chat2Skill captures conversations after each session, stores returned memory and skills in ~/.chat2skill/c2s.db, injects relevant local project context, and uses the configurable Stop response guard to enforce learned hard wording constraints.
defaultPrompt: Use Chat2Skill to retrieve relevant learned skills for this task.
Update Chat2Skill from the latest session.
Show me where Chat2Skill stored my generated skills.
